assessment.basis: Conditional parameter agreement from the complete 194-observation author-processed input regression. All five free parameters meet the recorded combined-error and numerical similarity criteria; the separate final-log comparison differs by less than 0.01 reported standard errors. Published source coefficients/covariance remain unchanged.
qualifications: All 194 author-processed observations, assigned P/T/value errors and scale groups are recovered. Original upstream reductions, calibration covariance and all exclusion decisions are not reconstructed.

The comparison uses the published EOS snapshot; Ross's later final log and its EosFit replay are separately compared in docs/literature-reproductions/pyrope-author-input-replay.md. Neither snapshot replaces the published coefficients or covariance.

The independent pressure-residual IRLS replay uses precise modulus inversion and local derivative effective variances. EosFit uses finite one-error displacements and approximate modulus inversion; the small parameter/error/chi-square differences are documented, not bitwise identity.

Refit errors are conditional local standard errors rescaled by reduced chi-square with effective coordinate weights frozen at the solution. Printed source errors retain their original convention; raw calibration/systematic uncertainty and shared-data cross-fit covariance remain unknown.

V0, Tr, n and volume scales are fixed; only the 15 high-pressure Sinogeikin–Bass (2000) modulus points share the refined scale. The two ambient points are unscaled. The nuisance scale is not a new EOS coefficient.
Numerical parameter agreement and processed-input replay do not establish complete raw-study author-workflow reproduction, experimental accuracy or a recommendation/default change.

fit.objective: Pressure residuals with iteratively frozen effective variances from all supplied P/T/value errors; separate from the public latent-coordinate fitter
fit.selection: All 194 rows of docs/data/garnet-angel-2022/pyrope/author-2026-11-14-inputs.csv: 115 volumes and 79 adiabatic moduli; no further exclusions
fit.weighting: Independent coordinate contributions in quadrature; local derivative propagation in the Python replay; original error tokens and exact scale groups retained
fit.solver_message: Two independent starts converge to the archived solution without reaching bounds
fit.covariance_convention: Conditional inverse-information covariance with final effective coordinate weights frozen, multiplied by chi-square/189; parameter order follows free_parameters

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Joint synthesis of experimental volume and adiabatic bulk-modulus observations, selected for consistency with measured heat capacities; includes adopted fixed molar V0.
parameter_provenance.volume_conversion: Vcell[A3] = Vm[cm3/mol] * 8 * 1e24 / NA, NA=6.02214076e23 mol^-1. Native volume=Vm/10 J/bar/mol.
parameter_provenance.uncertainty: Inline errors are the unchanged printed Table 1 widths; confidence is unspecified. The source-file covariance is retained independently and is used for propagation. It is conditional on fixed V0 and all source model/selection/calibration assumptions; omitted nuisance scale factors are marginalized by taking the EOS submatrix. No error is invented for adopted V0.
